title: GPT-Image-2
description: OpenAI GPT-Image-2 — next-generation image model with significantly improved text rendering. Text-to-image and image editing with up to 9 reference images, 1K/2K/4K output, and three quality levels. Billing: per image, resolution × quality — medium quality bills 60/120/180 credits at 1K/2K/4K, low bills half that (30/60/90), high bills 250/500/750.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

quality.description: Rendering quality. Multiplies the resolution price: low = 0.5x, medium = 1x, high ≈ 4.17x (e.g. at 1K: low 30, medium 60, high 250 credits).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Bills 60/120/180 credits per image (medium quality) at 1K/2K/4K.
